reviews.text:
I took my two dogs here for the first time today, and we had such a great experience! The entire staff was incredibly nice and welcoming, and we were seen very quickly with hardly any wait. The doctor was wonderful, listened to our concerns, and understood exactly what we wanted. I really appreciated that there was no pressure to get medications or vaccines that we didn't feel were necessary.
The whole visit was quick, smooth, and pleasant. We were in and out in a very reasonable amount of time. My neighbor, who also takes her dog here, recommended this place to us, and I'm so glad we gave it a try. We're very happy with the way they treated us and our dogs. I definitely recommend this place and will happily be coming back!
A huge warm shout out to Elisa! Thank you for accommodating Yosemite and Zions shot a few days earlier! I appreciate you 🍀
Thank you so much for the 4 star rating! We truly appreciate your support and hope to see you again soon.

Just moved to area and a neighbor recommended Larchmont Village Vet, what an incredible experience! Dr. Schultz listened so carefully and gave us so many easy solutions for our older dog. They went over all the options and associated costs - all less expensive than our previous vets. $72 was base cost for visit and it was worth twice that to learn what we did about our dog from Dr. Schultz. This is our new vet home - thanks to the great vet assistants and front desk too!

We had a wonderful experience with Larchmont Village Vet. Everyone we encountered was warm, caring, and professional, and our senior cat was treated with genuine kindness and attention throughout the visit.

The staff took the time to answer our questions and made the entire experience easy and reassuring. We truly appreciated the level of care and follow-up we received and would not hesitate to recommend Larchmont Village Vet to anyone looking for compassionate and attentive veterinary care.

I used to love this place, but it seems like it’s all about them making money. I needed to pick up one medication or preventative pill for flea intakes and then wanted me to make a full appointment just for them to tell me that my dog is healthy that’s bullshit.
Taken my dog here for the last 6+ years or so. Always great. Knowledgeable, and make sure to have the best treatment available for my dog. Very big fan here and highly recommend.
Thank you so much for the 5 star review! We truly appreciate your support and can’t wait to welcome you back soon! 🌟 …
Larchmont Village Vet is great! Prompt service, super friendly office staff, techs, and vets. Our two big dogs love them. I highly recommend them.
Dr Drayton and Stacy were excellent and took care of our little Lola
Such a wonderful staff and they are always so helpful. They really take the time to talk you through what is going on with your pet and what your options are.

I brought my 13 year old lab for what we thought was joint pain. It turned out to be Degenerative Myelopathy, a diagnosis that the vet completely missed and the arthritis medication he was prescribed nearly killed him. The vet seemed more interested in scolding us for his dental hygiene than looking into what we know now were very obvious signs of DM. After adding in a blood test upcharge for his thyroid and trying to sell the medication for double the price we will not be back. We are relieved his condition has improved after stopping the medication but we will not be back.

The staff here is so sweet and caring. I brought 2 of my pets here and they were so spoiled. The staff was fast and gentle with my kids. Im so greatful to Jessica the manager who gave my kitty so much Tlc before I had to let her go due to renal failure. Miguel and Maria were so amazing with my Chewy, so fast and gentle. They were careful not to stress him out since he was blind. Unfortunately he also was in acute renal failure. Never the less the staff here was companionate and very accommodating. Thank you all.

I cannot say enough good things about Larchmont Village Vet.
Every member of their staff is lovely...Special thanks to Dr Moffitt for being so thorough when approaching my dog's medical issues, as well as the kindest and most empathic man.
Really good. The people are so nice. Love it

Really upsetting to have to write this after so many years of bringing my dog here, along with my brother bringing both of his pets as well.

Last Wednesday, my dog suddenly woke up unable to walk, something was clearly wrong with his back right leg. Larchmont couldn’t see him until Friday, so I took him to an emergency vet in the meantime to manage his pain.

On Friday, I dropped him off and he was seen by Dr. Drayton, who told me there was a swollen knot on his back leg and prescribed an anti-inflammatory.

The next day, Saturday, I received a voicemail asking how my dog was doing. Unfortunately, he had taken a turn for the worse, his leg began bleeding profusely.
I rushed him back in, but a vet tech (who I will say was a very nice man and I want to exclude from the horrible experience) saw him for a few seconds and told me they couldn’t see him at all and that I needed to go to an emergency vet.
While that was incredibly frustrating, I do understand that clinics have schedules and limited availability.

What I cannot accept, however, was the level of care and compassion shown in that moment.
From the front desk, specifically Alicia, who showed little to no empathy both that day and during my appointment the day before, to the overall response from the team, I felt completely dismissed. No one helped guide me to an emergency facility, and I was made to feel like an inconvenience during a genuinely frightening situation.

Most upsetting of all, I asked multiple times if I could briefly speak with Dr. Drayton. I was told he didn’t have even five minutes.
He walked past me in the waiting room twice, and when I called out to him, he didn’t acknowledge me at all. This is a vet who has treated my dog for seven years, and in a moment of crisis, when my dog was actively bleeding, he couldn’t spare even a brief moment of reassurance.

I also requested both in person and over the phone that he follow up with me. I have yet to hear anything from anyone at the clinic.

My dog ended up having a ruptured abscess and required emergency surgery.

At this point, I no longer feel I have a reliable vet for follow-up care, and any hope that this situation would be addressed has been lost due to the complete lack of communication.

TL;DR: After nearly a decade as a loyal client, during my dog’s first serious medical emergency, I received no compassion, no communication, and not even a moment of acknowledgment from the vet who had treated him for years. Gutted.
Great clinic. The wait times are never too long, the staff is super friendly and helpful, and they’ve gone out of their way for us on multiple occasions.

I inherited an elderly Maltese a year ago and sadly, she had a stroke and needed to join her owner. This vet was so good about  handling the care without insane overcharging, or long lines, I think about switching care for my dog from the vet I've used for more than 20 years.
They helped me with everything I needed for my pet and very kind treatment with it too. I really recommend this place since they are very professional.

Great experience for my cat Hugo here, who I brought in for routine checkups and a flea and worm infestation. Dr. Moffit (sorry for misspell) is very thorough and communicative—he gives you a full sense of what your options are, the costs, and his recommendations, which is great for ppl who want to make informed decisions while keeping a reasonable eye on the budget. Hugo was well taken care of and is totally healthy now!
Very, efficient, good prices and I trusted the doctor. Always had a good experience with Larchmont Villiage Vet!

Larchmont Village Vet is truly wonderful. The entire team is incredibly kind, patient, and genuinely caring toward both pets and their owners. You can immediately tell how much they love animals by the way they handle them—so gentle, calm, and attentive.

They always take the time to explain everything clearly, answer questions, and make sure you never feel rushed. It’s such a relief knowing your pet is in the hands of people who truly care, not just about treatment but about your animal’s comfort and well-being. I’m so grateful to have found a vet I completely trust. Highly recommend!

Love this Vet. I just went to Dr. Drayton and he is so kind and reassuring. They give you a breakdown before you do services so you can choose what you want to do in your visit and aren't gauged with costs. My anxious dog does pretty well here!
Doctor was super sweet and made me and Piper comfortable through the whole process. I very highly recommend!

I've been to a few vets in the area (Melrose, Beverly Robertson, etc), and Larchmont Village Vet is easily the best experience we've had. The staff and customer service experience is miles beyond the aforementioned facilities.
Leo Muffin and i love this vet office, always a great service and friendly staff and amazing vet doctors 🥰🥰🥰 …
Highly recommend if your looking for a vet. They helped my Frenchy and his baby rolls and he wasn't even the reason we were there.  Very knowledgeable and friendly. Enjoy.
Best ver in LA! Look no further. 🥰 🐾 …

Writing this review has been incredibly difficult, but I’m sharing our experience in hopes that it helps others make an informed decision when choosing a vet for their fur babies.

My family and I have been going to Larchmont Village Vet for years. We were never fully satisfied—everything always felt just okay—but we continued giving them the benefit of the doubt because finding a new vet is daunting, especially when a life you love is in their hands.

I will never return after what happened with our beloved dog.

We brought him in for a simple ear cleaning. Nothing unusual was going on that day. He had recently begun experiencing seizures, but he was on medication and doing well. What should have been a routine visit quickly turned into a crisis. A tech came out to tell us he was suddenly having a seizure. We were shocked and immediately asked to go back and be with him to help calm him, but we were denied and kept in the lobby. We never got to see him during the episode.

We were later told he was having cluster seizures—something he had never experienced before. Based on how frantic and unsure the staff seemed, I couldn’t shake the feeling that he may have been handled too roughly or without the gentleness he needed in his condition. Of course, I can’t say for certain what happened out of our sight, but that concern has weighed heavily on me.

Their only advice was to rush him to the hospital. When they finally released him to us, we took him straight to ACCESS, where the team handled the emergency calmly, confidently, and with compassion.

What added even more hurt was the complete lack of care afterward. Not a single call to check on him, despite our many years as clients. They also never returned our message when we reached out with a question about the ear medication they had given us. Also just to note they charged us for everything, the entire visit despite not getting the full service.

I’m not saying they directly caused his seizure, but I deeply regret bringing him in that day. Our pup has since passed away, and the indifference we experienced from this clinic added unnecessary pain to an already devastating situation.

Please be cautious when trusting this place with your animal’s care.

I chose a vet prior to coming to Larchmont, I immediately walked into this vet and knew I made the correct choice switching. They’re clean, amazingly nice staff and my dog was in great hands. They were so caring towards him that I knew we found our forever vet.
Fast and always nice! My dog is happy to go to the vet!

This is my first experience with the Larchmont Village Vet and everyone was so kind, gave me such attentive time, and really made me feel better about everything. I love my cats so much and the vet and techs really took the time to explain everything, provide me options, and were gentle with two cats who would rather be anywhere but there. I HIGHLY recommend.

We love Larchmont Village Vet! We tried a few other vets before finding this place, and we’re so happy we did. You can truly see how much they love pets, and we always feel comfortable bringing our cat Marceline here. Dr. Haddy is the best — caring, knowledgeable, and attentive. Highly recommend!

This will be my go to vet moving forward! Not only was I able to get a convenient appointment (they have flexible hours) but they were kind and patient. Dr Moffitt was diligent and explained absolutely everything to ensure that we were getting every answer to every question. Prices were reasonable and everything was explained to make sure I was comfortable. They also gave me a follow-up call to check in on my kitty to make sure she is still doing well. Extremely satisfied and definitely visit again.
Staff are very caring,  friendly and knowledgeable.

You cannot buy simple products like FORTIFLORA (probiotics). The man (receptionist) refuses to sell me a box for my dog that was ill, asking me if my dog was a patient. Also advised me to buy it on Amazon.

Larchmont Village Vet is a great facility. Very carrying, attentive staff & doctors, they take great care of your loved one. when you need them--for follow-up questions, or your pet's charts--they are always there for you & unfailingly courteous & helpful (they recognize your pet from your phone number, so they have all your information at their fingertips anytime you call). It's also a spanking clean office. We've seen two of their doctors and they're always first-rate! Thank you Larchmont Village Vet!!
Always takes great care of my dog, he loves going to the vet ever since he was a pup. Workers are kind and always explain everything well.

The new office is really lovely and comfortable. The technicians and vets are always so calming and caring with my little man.

I appreciate that they take the time to explain what procedures might be needed and are always transparent about my options.
Village Vet was recommended to me by my old vet who retired. They are caring and awesome. Highly recommend.
Excellent, in all ways. Highly recommend.

Larchmont Village Vet has always been a neighborhood gem, and their recent move to a larger space only makes the experience better! The new facility is absolutely beautiful—modern, clean, welcoming, and thoughtfully designed with pets in mind. They even stock my dog's favorite freeze dried salmon treats in the exam room!

Even with the new location, the same amazing team is still here. The veterinarians and staff are incredibly knowledgeable, compassionate, and attentive. It’s such a relief to know that my pet is in the hands of people who truly care and take the time to explain everything clearly.

So grateful they kept the same wonderful team in this gorgeous new space. Highly recommend Larchmont Village Vet to anyone looking for top-notch care in a setting that feels warm and professional.
Great place to go if you like giving lots of money to people who don't care about you or your pet.

We take both our dogs here for everything from grooming to vaccines. The front desk is always welcoming and they remember our pets by name. It doesn’t feel like a typical rushed clinic. Highly recommend them to anyone in LA.

Seems like they changed staffs and they’re more friendly than before. Been bringing my pups here for grooming and for some vaccinations/examinations. Place is clean and I like the people who works there now. 👍🏻 keep up the good work. I even recommended the place to one of my co workers and they liked the place. 👍🏻 …
